overall_decision.reason: The capacity-102 same-byte packed layout, exact measured 75-to-100-slot reinvestment, and current MTP speed configuration fail. Trace-local route recall is insufficient for runtime promotion, not proof that all hint-only predictors fail. Fixed-slot Q8 and general hint-only prediction remain open; Track 4 lacks a valid artifact and quality contract.

gpu_oriented_layout.decision: Stop before an exact packed QMV, v2 codec, sidecar, or runtime integration because the upper 95% confidence bound is only 0.491%, below the fixed 5% gate.

physical_kv_bytes.note: Both benchmark arms intentionally used the same physical Q8 KV cache; the measured mechanism was reinvesting the accounting difference into expert slots.

kv_budget_exchange.open_followup: Fixed-slot BF16-versus-Q8 attention and quality at true 4K/16K/64K/128K contexts.
kv_budget_exchange.decision: Do not reintroduce the 100-slot Q8 reinvestment plan. Keep Q8-vs-BF16 at fixed expert capacity open as a separate representation/quality experiment.

hint_only_prediction.open_followup: Held-out and cross-session offline prediction with a zero-prediction scheduling control, physical cache amplification, interference, lead time, and net latency.
hint_only_prediction.physical_byte_amplification_note: Unmeasured after cache hits, deduplication, cancellation, contention, and interference.
hint_only_prediction.decision: Do not add a prefetch API from same-trace recall or a route adapter for the current MTP configuration. Keep the general offline hint-only experiment open; the authoritative trunk router remains the only routing authority.

lower_bit_cold_tier.current_runtime_contract: Pinned Hy3 affine Q4/group-64 only; non-Q4 record-native specifications fail closed.
lower_bit_cold_tier.decision: Do not create or label a lower-bit artifact without a pinned BF16-to-lower-bit conversion, explicit identity, native-kernel enforcement, and predeclared perplexity/reasoning/tool-use/long-generation quality gates.

measured_vs_inferred.track1_stream_floor_headroom: historical values calculated; capacity-102 packed-vs-split stream floor measured from a clean committed harness
measured_vs_inferred.track2_exact_full_75_to_100_slot_runtime: measured on the recorded host and configuration; fixed-slot Q8-vs-BF16 unmeasured
measured_vs_inferred.track3_same_trace_recall_mtp_acceptance_: measured; physical byte amplification and general predictor net latency unmeasured
